subject: mathematics
title: Shape Moves
objective: Describe the resulting figure after a slide, turn, or flip using a model.
introduction: Milo moves a paper triangle across a grid. Can you tell whether it slides, turns, or flips?

rotates the shape one quarter of a full spin
turns the shape over like a mirror image

items.prompt: Which move glides a shape to a new spot without turning it?
items.explanation: A slide glides the shape to a new spot without turning it, so the shape slid right. Turning, flipping, and shrinking are different moves.

items.prompt: Which move rotates a shape one quarter of a full spin?
items.explanation: A quarter-turn rotates the shape one quarter of a full spin, like turning a wheel from 12 to 3. Slides and flips do not rotate the shape, and shrinking changes its size.

items.prompt: Which move turns a shape over like a mirror image?
items.explanation: A flip turns the shape over across a line, like a mirror image. Slides and turns keep the shape facing the same way, and shrinking changes its size.

items.prompt: A triangle slides right. What stays the same after the move?

options.text: its shape, but not its size

items.explanation: A slide only moves the triangle to a new spot, so its shape and size stay the same. Only the position on the page changes.

items.prompt: Milo's square moves 3 steps to the right. Which move did he use?
items.explanation: Moving straight to a new spot is a slide, so the square slid right. A turn rotates it, a flip turns it over, and a shrink makes it smaller.
